summary: Iteration 519 — Tested (1) Open Pricing Optimizer ±15% guardrail, (2) Overbooking 1-click apply, (3) Revenue Brain permanent memory (append-only), plus smoke regression. Backend: all 5 pytest cases pass. Frontend: Revenue Brain panel + Kalıcı Hafıza dark section renders; property switch to city-gate shows KRITIK DERS card with 7× doğrulandı and İlk öğrenme date; Şimdi Öğren works. Overbooking & wash control panel opens (via PRO → Revenue & Rates → Tools), 'Limitleri Kanallara Uygula (1 tık)' button works, ob-applied-info strip appears with green ✓, Uygulanan column shows green ✓+1 badges.

issues: Overbooking & wash control button is only available in PRO mode (nested under REVENUE & RATES → Tools). It is not discoverable in BASIT mode. Documented in review_request Turkish note; not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend hot-reload watchfiles watches /app/backend/tests/, so writing pytest files there caused backend to reload/hang. Moved tests to /app/tests/ instead. Consider excluding tests/ from uvicorn --reload watch paths.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. city-gate property already had seeded outcomes; permanent memory 'first_learned' remains 2026-08-14, times_confirmed observed to grow across successive learn calls (verified 6→7 during tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guardrail comparison uses response shape: {matrix:[{date, cells:{'segment|channel': rate}}]}. Overbooking panel requires PRO mode (button:has-text('PRO')) then click sidebar section header 'Revenue & Rates' to expand; then Tools → overbooking-control-btn. Revenue Brain 'city-gate' has meaningful memory; 'default' returns empty which is correct.
rca of the issue: Initial backend timeouts were caused by watchfiles reloading backend when I created a test file under /app/backend/tests/. Fix: place test file in /app/tests/ (not watched). One backend restart via supervisorctl was required to recover the hung reload.
